lessonTranslationNote: Canonically reviewed Buddhist doctrinal terms and titles in priority language.

CI_001.name: 悅俱邪見相應無行貪根心
CI_001.doctrinalNote: 阿毗達摩法數之心識分類：Somanassa-sahagataṃ Diṭṭhigatasampayuttaṃ Asaṅkhārikaṃ。
examples: Taking delight in helping oneself to someone else's belongings, thinking 'it doesn't matter'
Greed accompanied by the wrong view that possessions are permanent

CI_002.name: 悅俱邪見相應有行貪根心
CI_002.doctrinalNote: 阿毗達摩法數之心識分類：Somanassa-sahagataṃ Diṭṭhigatasampayuttaṃ Sasaṅkhārikaṃ。
examples: Taking someone else's belongings only after being egged on by another
Greed that arises after persuasion, having deliberated before deciding

CI_003.name: 悅俱邪見不相應無行貪根心
CI_003.doctrinalNote: 阿毗達摩法數之心識分類：Somanassa-sahagataṃ Diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ Asaṅkhārikaṃ。
examples: Pride and delight in acquiring something for oneself
Wanting something out of conceit, comparing oneself favourably with others

CI_004.name: 悅俱邪見不相應有行貪根心
CI_004.doctrinalNote: 阿毗達摩法數之心識分類：Somanassa-sahagataṃ Diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ Sasaṅkhārikaṃ。
examples: Greed mixed with conceit arising only after being incited by someone else

CI_005.name: 捨俱邪見相應無行貪根心

CI_006.name: 捨俱邪見相應有行貪根心

RP_001.name: 地界
RP_001.description: 硬或軟的特性，作為其他俱生色的立足與支持基礎。
RP_001.doctrinalNote: The four great elements always arise together, inseparably. There is no materiality in the immaterial realm.

RP_002.name: 水界
RP_002.description: 流動或凝聚的特性，使伴隨色聚聚合而不分散。
RP_002.doctrinalNote: The water element is the only great element that cannot be directly sensed through bodily contact.

RP_003.name: 火界
RP_003.description: 冷或熱的特性，主成熟與溫養一切物質。
RP_003.doctrinalNote: When occurring independently as external heat (utu), the fire element gives rise to temperature-produced materiality (utu-samuṭṭhāna-rūpa).

RP_004.name: 風界
RP_004.description: 支持與波動的特性，主物質的張力與運動。
RP_004.doctrinalNote: In the practice of ānāpānasati, the breath (air element) is the principal meditation object.

RP_005.name: 眼淨色
RP_005.description: 對光色所緣敏感的眼根清淨透明色法。
RP_005.doctrinalNote: Produced only by kamma. Not present in the immaterial realm.

RP_006.name: 耳淨色
RP_006.description: 對聲音所緣敏感的耳根清淨透明色法。
RP_006.doctrinalNote: Brahmās of the fine-material realm possess the ear faculty because they communicate through sound.

RP_007.name: 鼻淨色
RP_007.description: 對香氣所緣敏感的鼻根清淨透明色法。
RP_007.doctrinalNote: Occurs only in the sense-sphere realm. Brahmās of the fine-material realm lack the nose faculty.

RP_008.name: 舌淨色
RP_008.description: 對味道所緣敏感的舌根清淨透明色法。
RP_008.doctrinalNote: Occurs only in the sense-sphere realm. Brahmās do not eat, so they lack the tongue faculty.

RP_009.name: 身淨色
RP_009.description: 遍布全身對觸覺敏感的清淨透明色法。
RP_009.doctrinalNote: Brahmās of the fine-material realm possess the body faculty. It is absent in the non-percipient realm.

RP_010.name: 色所緣
RP_010.description: 眼根所見之顏色與光明。
RP_010.doctrinalNote: Visible form (colour) is distinct from materiality (matter) in general.

RP_013.name: 味所緣
RP_013.description: 舌根所嚐之酸甜苦辣等味。

RP_014.name: 女根色
RP_014.description: 決定女性身體形態、語音、行為等女性特徵之色法。
RP_014.doctrinalNote: Occurs only in the sense-sphere realm. Brahmās of the fine-material realm have no sex faculty.

RP_015.name: 男根色
RP_015.description: 決定男性身體形態、語音、行為等男性特徵之色法。
RP_015.doctrinalNote: Occurs only in the sense-sphere realm.

RP_016.name: 心所依處
RP_016.description: 意界與意識界（心識）生起的物質依托處。
RP_016.doctrinalNote: Absent in the immaterial realm. This is the most important material basis in the Abhidhamma system of cognition.

RP_017.name: 命根色
RP_017.description: 維持業生色法壽命與存續的色法機能。
RP_017.doctrinalNote: The lifespan of materiality equals seventeen mind-moments. When material life faculty ceases, the kamma-produced materiality ceases with it.

RP_018.name: 段食
RP_018.description: 食物中的食素（營養），維持身體滋長。
RP_018.doctrinalNote: Nutritive essence in physical food (kabaḷīkāra-āhāra) is one of the four kinds of nutriment in the Abhidhamma.

RP_019.name: 空界
RP_019.description: 界限與分劃色聚之間的虛空空間。
RP_019.doctrinalNote: The space element as a material phenomenon is not the same as absolute space in philosophy.

RP_020.name: 身表
RP_020.description: 因心意而通過身體動作表達意圖之色法。
RP_020.doctrinalNote: Produced only by mind. It is the basis of bodily action (kāya-kamma).

RP_021.name: 語表
RP_021.description: 因心意而通過言語聲音表達意圖之色法。
RP_021.doctrinalNote: Produced only by mind. It is the basis of verbal action (vacī-kamma).

RP_022.name: 色輕快性
RP_022.description: 色身無重滯、敏捷靈活的變異狀態。
RP_022.doctrinalNote: Not produced by kamma. Depends on present health and conditions.

RP_023.name: 色柔軟性
RP_023.description: 色身柔軟順從、無僵硬的變異狀態。

RP_024.name: 色適業性
RP_024.description: 色身適於動作與作業、勝任活動的變異狀態。

RP_025.name: 色積聚
RP_025.description: 生命初期諸根初生與生長之色法生相。
RP_025.doctrinalNote: The four characteristics of materiality are phases of all material phenomena, not independent material instances.

RP_026.name: 色相續
RP_026.description: 根色完全後物質不斷繼續產生之相。
RP_026.doctrinalNote: Continuity explains why things seem stable to us — they are in fact an unbroken stream of arising and passing away.

RP_027.name: 色老性
RP_027.description: 物質成熟趨向老化變質之衰老相。
RP_027.doctrinalNote: Decay is the clearest visible sign of impermanence (anicca) in materiality.

RP_028.name: 色無常性
RP_028.description: 物質完全碎裂瓦解與滅盡之壞滅相。
RP_028.doctrinalNote: Clearly seeing the phase of dissolution is the starting point of insight meditation (vipassanā).

PC_01.name: 因緣
PC_01.definition: 貪、瞋、癡、無貪、無瞋、無癡六根如樹根般穩固俱生名色。
PC_01.paccayaDhamma: The six roots: greed (lobha), hatred (dosa), delusion (moha), non-greed (alobha), non-hatred (adosa), non-delusion (amoha).
PC_01.paccayuppanna: The mind states associated with a root (citta and cetasikas), and the materiality that mind produces — mind-born materiality in the course of existence, kamma-born materiality at rebirth.
PC_01.doctrinalNote: Only the six root cetasikas are roots; however strong the other mental factors may be, they support their states only through other conditions.
examples: A greed-rooted consciousness carries the two roots greed and delusion: together they make the whole mind-moment unwholesome.
A rootless (ahetuka) consciousness has no root and therefore receives no root condition — for example, the two receiving consciousnesses.

PC_02.name: 所緣緣
PC_02.definition: 色、聲、香、味、觸、法六所緣如手杖引心心所攀附生起。
PC_02.paccayaDhamma: The six objects: visible form, sound, odour, taste, tangible data, and mind objects (including Nibbāna and meditative attainments).
PC_02.paccayuppanna: All 89 cittas — every citta that knows an object — together with the 52 mental factors.
PC_02.doctrinalNote: According to Visuddhimagga XVII, ignorance serves as object condition for wholesome formations when a meditator examines ignorance with wisdom.
examples: A visible object (an image) serves as object condition for eye-consciousness and its associated mental factors.
Nibbāna serves as object condition for supramundane consciousness.

PC_03.name: 增上緣
PC_03.definition: 欲、精進、心、審察四增上如輪王統攝一切俱生法。
PC_03.paccayaDhamma: The four conascent dominants — desire-to-act (chanda), energy (viriya), consciousness (citta), and investigation (vīmaṃsā, wisdom); and the predominant object.
PC_03.paccayuppanna: The mental states that arise together with a dominant; for the predominant object, the 84 cittas (excluding rootless resultant cittas) and their associated mental factors.
PC_03.doctrinalNote: No predominance condition occurs among the 18 rootless cittas, nor in cittas where only one dominant is possible.
examples: When a meditator's effort is at its strongest, energy predominates over the whole jhāna mind-moment.
A person besotted with a precious thing: that thing is the predominant object for the greedy mind.

Sahajāt'ādhipati.name: Conascent dominance
Sahajāt'ādhipati.note: One of the four — desire, energy, consciousness, investigation — that stands out in a single mind-moment.

Ārammaṇ'ādhipati.name: Object dominance
Ārammaṇ'ādhipati.note: An object held predominant, governing the mind that takes it as its object.

PC_04.name: 無間緣
PC_04.definition: 前滅之心心所毫無間隔地開闢道路引後心生起。
PC_04.paccayaDhamma: The consciousness and mental factors that have just ceased (except the dying consciousness of an Arahant).
PC_04.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors that arise immediately afterwards.
PC_04.doctrinalNote: Proximity condition underlies the continuity of the stream of consciousness — there is no gap between two mind-moments.
examples: Eye-consciousness, on ceasing, is proximity condition for the receiving consciousness in a five-door process.
The rebirth-linking consciousness, on ceasing, is proximity condition for the first life-continuum moment.

PC_05.name: 等無間緣
PC_05.definition: 前心以完全等同且井然有序之次第導引後心相續。
PC_05.paccayaDhamma: The consciousness and mental factors that have just ceased.
PC_05.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors that follow immediately.
PC_05.doctrinalNote: These two conditions are one reality, differing only in presentation — like the two sides of a coin.
examples: The same relation is called proximity when spoken of as 'giving way', and contiguity when spoken of as 'following immediately'.

PC_06.name: 俱生緣
PC_06.definition: 同生之名色如燈生光、四柱立廈般相互資助支持。
PC_06.paccayaDhamma: The four mental aggregates that arise together; the four great essentials; mind and its factors in the course of existence; and name and materiality at rebirth.
PC_06.paccayuppanna: The mental states conascent with one another, mind-born and kamma-born materiality in the course of existence, and the name–materiality that support one another at rebirth.
PC_06.doctrinalNote: This is the condition most used to explain the simultaneity of name and materiality within a single mind-moment.
examples: In one greedy mind-moment, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness arise together and support one another.
At rebirth-linking, the rebirth consciousness and kamma-born materiality support each other through conascence condition.

PC_07.name: 相互緣
PC_07.definition: 俱生名色如三腳架支柱般彼此相互依賴共立。
PC_07.paccayaDhamma: The four conascent mental aggregates; the four great essentials; name and materiality at rebirth.
PC_07.paccayuppanna: Those very states — the relation is two-way.
PC_07.doctrinalNote: Mutuality always accompanies conascence, but is narrower: materiality born of mind is not mutual with consciousness.
examples: The four great essentials: the earth element supports the water element and the water element supports the earth — no element stands alone.

PC_08.name: 依止緣
PC_08.definition: 如大地載植樹木、畫布受敷丹青般作為所依支柱。
PC_08.paccayaDhamma: The four conascent mental aggregates; the four great essentials; and the six bases (eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and heart-base).
PC_08.paccayuppanna: The conascent mental states; derived materiality; and the seven consciousness-elements together with their mental factors.
PC_08.doctrinalNote: Distinguish from decisive support: dependence is the direct base, decisive support is strong assistance from a distance.
examples: The eye-base is dependence condition for eye-consciousness and its associated mental factors.
The heart-base (hadaya-vatthu) supports the whole mind-consciousness element throughout the life of the five aggregates.

Sahajāta-nissaya.name: Conascent dependence
Sahajāta-nissaya.note: Mutual reliance within a single mind-moment.

Purejāta-nissaya (vatthu).name: Prenascence dependence — bases
Purejāta-nissaya (vatthu).note: The six bases, arisen beforehand, serve as the support for the seven consciousness-elements.

Vatthārammaṇa-purejāta-nissaya.name: Base-object prenascence dependence
Vatthārammaṇa-purejāta-nissaya.note: The heart-base serves at once as base and as object for mind-element consciousness.

PC_09.name: 親依止緣
PC_09.definition: 強有力的因緣、所緣或積習如暴風沛雨般強力驅遣引生後法。
PC_09.paccayaDhamma: An object strongly attended to; consciousness that has just ceased; and natural conditions such as faith, virtue, climate, food, and friends.
PC_09.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors that arise afterwards.
PC_09.doctrinalNote: The link Feeling → Craving in dependent origination is explained chiefly through natural decisive support.
examples: Pleasant feeling is natural decisive support for craving — because feeling is agreeable, craving grows strong.
Faith decisively supports an act of generosity; greed decisively supports an act of stealing.

Ārammaṇ'ūpanissaya.name: Object decisive support
Ārammaṇ'ūpanissaya.note: A powerful object becomes the decisive spur for the consciousness that follows.

Anantar'ūpanissaya.name: Contiguous decisive support
Anantar'ūpanissaya.note: Equivalent to proximity condition considered as a force of support.

Pakat'ūpanissaya.name: Natural decisive support
Pakat'ūpanissaya.note: Natural conditions: faith, virtue, climate, friends, former kamma.

PC_10.name: 前生緣
PC_10.definition: 先已生起且正現住之根身與所緣為後生識作依托。
PC_10.paccayaDhamma: The six bases (materiality) and the six objects — the concrete material phenomena — that have already arisen.
PC_10.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors that arise later.
PC_10.doctrinalNote: Prenascence applies only to materiality; mental states cannot be prenascence conditions.
examples: The eye-base must exist first; only then can eye-consciousness arise.
A present visible object (17 mind-moments long) serves as prenascence condition for an eye-door process.

Vatthu-purejāta.name: Base prenascence
Vatthu-purejāta.note: The six bases support the seven consciousness-elements.

Ārammaṇa-purejāta.name: Object prenascence
Ārammaṇa-purejāta.note: Present concrete objects support the 54 sense-sphere cittas and 50 mental factors.

PC_11.name: 後生緣
PC_11.definition: 後生之心心所如潤澤春雨般輔助滋養先已生之色身。
PC_11.paccayaDhamma: The 85 cittas of the sense-sphere, form-sphere, formless-sphere and supramundane planes — that is, all consciousness except the rebirth-linking cittas — together with the 52 mental factors.
PC_11.paccayuppanna: The kamma-born body of materiality that arose earlier (the materiality of the living body).
PC_11.doctrinalNote: Only later-arising mentality supports earlier materiality; never the reverse.
examples: Mind and mental factors during life support the body already born, keeping it from decay.
Hunger drives one to eat — later-arising mentality nourishes earlier-born materiality.

PC_12.name: 習行緣
PC_12.definition: 前前同類速行不斷熏習重複使後後速行力量純熟強固。
PC_12.paccayaDhamma: The preceding impulsion consciousness and its mental factors (except the final impulsion and the path impulsion).
PC_12.paccayuppanna: The impulsion consciousness and its factors arising immediately after.
PC_12.doctrinalNote: A supramundane path impulsion is not repetition condition, because it arises for a single mind-moment only.
examples: Among the seven impulsions, the first is repetition condition for the second.
Memorising by repeated recitation makes each later attempt easier — the same principle at work.

PC_13.name: 業緣
PC_13.definition: 善與不善之思心所造作成熟，引生後後異熟果報。
PC_13.paccayaDhamma: Wholesome and unwholesome volition — the cetanā mental factor.
PC_13.paccayuppanna: Conascent kamma: the citta and cetasikas arising with it, and mind-born materiality. Asynchronous kamma: resultant consciousness, its mental factors, and kamma-born materiality at rebirth.
PC_13.doctrinalNote: The links Formations → Consciousness and Becoming → Birth among the twelve links are explained through asynchronous kamma condition.
examples: Volition in an act of generosity supports resultant mind and kamma-born materiality in a future life (asynchronous kamma).
Volition in a greedy mind-moment makes that whole mind-moment unwholesome (conascent kamma).

Sahajāta-kamma.name: Conascent kamma
Sahajāta-kamma.note: Volition supports the states arising with it in the same mind-moment.

Nānākkhaṇika-kamma.name: Asynchronous kamma
Nānākkhaṇika-kamma.note: Volition in one mind-moment supports its result in another — the basis of rebirth.

PC_14.name: 異熟緣
PC_14.definition: 業報所感之異熟名法安穩寂靜無為地互為滋養資助。
PC_14.paccayaDhamma: The 36 resultant cittas (rootless, sense-sphere beautiful, and great resultants) together with their 38 associated mental factors.
PC_14.paccayuppanna: The resultant mental states that arise together, and the kamma-born materiality they produce.
PC_14.doctrinalNote: Resultant consciousness creates no new kamma — the key point for understanding that 'a result does not produce a result'.
examples: Rebirth-linking consciousness is a resultant: it supports the kamma-born materiality arising together with it.
Eye-consciousness is resultant mind — it supports its conascent mental factors by result condition without creating new kamma.

PC_15.name: 食緣
PC_15.definition: 段食及三名食（觸、意思、識）支持滋養肉身與精神命脈。
PC_15.paccayaDhamma: Edible food (materiality) and the three mental nutriments: contact, volition, and consciousness.
PC_15.paccayuppanna: Food materiality sustains the body; the three mental nutriments sustain mind, mental factors, and mind-born materiality.
PC_15.doctrinalNote: Connect with the Four Nutriments in the Sutta Piṭaka (SN 12.63) — the contemplation of nutriment.
examples: Food sustains the material body — edible food.
Volition nutriment: intention feeds kamma and prolongs the round of birth and death.

Nām'āhāra.name: Mental nutriment
Nām'āhāra.note: Contact, volition, and consciousness as nutriments.

PC_16.name: 根緣
PC_16.definition: 二十二根在各自管轄領域中發揮統治宰制支配作用。
PC_16.paccayaDhamma: The 20 faculties: five sensitive material faculties, the material life faculty, and fourteen mental faculties — feeling, faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration, wisdom, the three understanding faculties, and the mind faculty.
PC_16.paccayuppanna: The sensitive faculties support the seven consciousness-elements; the mental faculties support the conascent mind and its factors; the material life faculty sustains kamma-born materiality.
PC_16.doctrinalNote: The five spiritual faculties — faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration, wisdom — must be balanced in meditation.
examples: The eye faculty governs eye-consciousness — without the eye faculty there is no seeing.
The concentration faculty rules the whole jhāna mind-moment.

Purejāta-indriya.name: Prenascence faculties
Purejāta-indriya.note: The five sensitive faculties support the consciousnesses they correspond to.

Jīvit'indriya.name: Material life faculty
Jīvit'indriya.note: Sustains the kamma-born materiality of its own group.

Sahajāta-indriya.name: Conascent faculties
Sahajāta-indriya.note: The fourteen mental faculties support the mind and factors arising with them.

PC_17.name: 禪那緣
PC_17.definition: 尋、伺、喜、樂、一境性等支緊密繫縛心於所緣寂靜內觀。
PC_17.paccayaDhamma: The seven jhāna factors: applied thought, sustained thought, rapture, pleasure, displeasure, equanimity, and one-pointedness.
PC_17.paccayuppanna: The associated mind and mental factors (except the two body consciousnesses), and the materiality produced by that mind.
PC_17.doctrinalNote: Not limited to meditative attainment: the seven jhāna factors operate in ordinary consciousness as well.
examples: Applied thought brings the mind to the object — it is jhāna condition for the factors arising with it.
In the second jhāna applied thought is absent, yet rapture and one-pointedness still function as jhāna condition.

PC_18.name: 道緣
PC_18.definition: 正見等八正道支引領眾生脫離輪迴導向解脫涅槃。
PC_18.paccayaDhamma: The twelve path factors: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration — and wrong view, wrong intention, wrong effort, wrong one-pointedness.
PC_18.paccayuppanna: The associated mind and mental factors (except the two body consciousnesses), and the materiality produced by that mind.
PC_18.doctrinalNote: Path condition operates in wholesome and unwholesome states alike — not only in the supramundane Noble Eightfold Path.
examples: Right view in a wholesome mind steers the whole mind-moment toward the wholesome.
Wrong view in a greedy mind steers it toward the unwholesome — path condition has two faces.

PC_19.name: 相應緣
PC_19.definition: 心與心所同生、同滅、同所依、同所緣，如水乳交融般無別。
PC_19.paccayuppanna: Those very four aggregates — a two-way relation.
PC_19.doctrinalNote: Only mentality can be associated; materiality has no shared object and base, so it cannot be associated.
examples: Feeling and perception in one mind-moment are associated: they know one object through one base.

PC_20.name: 不相應緣
PC_20.definition: 名法與色法體性相異（如油與水），卻互相依存扶持。
PC_20.paccayaDhamma: Mental states (when supporting materiality), or material phenomena (when supporting mentality).
PC_20.paccayuppanna: Material phenomena (conascent or prenascent), or mental states (conascent or postnascent).
PC_20.doctrinalNote: This condition expresses the mind–matter relation, the backbone of the Name-and-Form analysis among the twelve links.
examples: The heart-base (materiality) supports mind-consciousness (mentality) — different kinds, hence dissociation condition.
At rebirth-linking, the rebirth consciousness and kamma-born materiality arise together yet remain different kinds.

Sahajāta-vippayutta.name: Conascent dissociation
Sahajāta-vippayutta.note: Mind and materiality arise together yet support each other as different kinds — at rebirth-linking.

Purejāta-vippayutta.name: Prenascence dissociation
Purejāta-vippayutta.note: The six bases, arisen earlier, support the seven consciousness-elements.

Pacchājāta-vippayutta.name: Postnascence dissociation
Pacchājāta-vippayutta.note: Later-arising mentality supports the earlier-born body of materiality.

PC_21.name: 有緣
PC_21.definition: 正現存之法以其現有存在狀態，支持其他同時現存之法。
PC_21.paccayaDhamma: Comprises the states serving as conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions.
PC_21.paccayuppanna: The states supported by those five conditions.
PC_21.doctrinalNote: The widest of the 24 conditions — it subsumes five others.
examples: The eye-base being present, eye-consciousness can arise — presence condition.
The four great essentials being present support the derived materiality.

Indriya-atthi.name: Faculty presence
Indriya-atthi.note: The material life faculty being present.

PC_22.name: 無有緣
PC_22.definition: 前心心所滅去不復存在，唯以此“斷滅空位”給後心讓出生起機會。
PC_22.paccayaDhamma: The consciousness and mental factors that have just ceased.
PC_22.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors arising immediately after.
PC_22.doctrinalNote: Same scope as proximity condition, but stressing the absence of the preceding consciousness.
examples: Eye-consciousness must cease for the receiving consciousness to arise.

PC_23.name: 離去緣
PC_23.definition: 前法離去、消逝與退讓，促成後法生起無阻。
PC_23.paccayaDhamma: The consciousness and mental factors that have just ceased.
PC_23.paccayuppanna: The mind and mental factors arising immediately after.
PC_23.doctrinalNote: One reality, two sayings: absence stresses 'no longer there'; disappearance stresses 'has gone'.
examples: A life-continuum moment, just ceased (disappeared), supports the next life-continuum moment.

PC_24.name: 不離去緣
PC_24.definition: 法未曾離去、正處於當前現住狀態，繼續維持伴隨法。
PC_24.paccayaDhamma: Comprises the states serving as conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty conditions.
PC_24.paccayuppanna: The states supported by those five conditions.
PC_24.doctrinalNote: The pairs 21–24 (presence / absence / disappearance / non-disappearance) close the 24 conditions with two pairs of synonyms.
examples: The heart-base, not yet perished, keeps supporting mind-consciousness.

PD_01.name: 無明
PD_01.description: 不了知四聖諦、三世因果與十二緣起之愚癡蒙昧。
PD_01.doctrinalNote: Avijjā has no discernible beginning (anamatagga). The ending of ignorance is the attainment of the four path consciousnesses.
examples: Not knowing this body is impermanent, one clings to it as a self and creates kamma to protect that self.

PD_02.name: 行
PD_02.description: 以無明為緣而造作身、口、意善惡諸業。
PD_02.doctrinalNote: Saṅkhārā in dependent origination means the volition (cetanā) mental factor that forms kamma.
examples: Giving with a wholesome mind is a meritorious formation; its consciousness rebirth-links into a good destination.
Attaining jhāna is an imperturbable formation; its consciousness rebirth-links as a Brahmā.

PD_03.name: 識
PD_03.description: 由業力牽引於母胎初起之結生識及六識身。
PD_03.doctrinalNote: Consciousness and mind-and-matter lean on each other — like two sheaves of reeds propping one another up.
examples: At the moment of conception the rebirth-linking consciousness appears, mind-and-matter develop, and a new life begins.

PD_04.name: 名色
PD_04.description: 精神諸蘊（受想行）與物質諸蘊於結生時俱起生展。
examples: In the womb: rebirth consciousness appears and mind-and-matter gradually develop from embryo to full term.

PD_05.name: 六處
PD_05.description: 眼耳鼻舌身意六入處，領受境界之門戶。
examples: A newborn child: with the six bases complete, contact with the outside world begins.

PD_06.name: 觸
PD_06.description: 根、境、識三者和合碰觸，引發受領。
PD_06.doctrinalNote: Phassa in dependent origination is the contact mental factor (CS_PHASSA).
examples: The eye sees a lovely object: eye-base + visible object + eye-consciousness give eye-contact, and glad feeling follows.

PD_07.name: 受
PD_07.description: 觸所緣後所感受之苦、樂、捨之味。
PD_07.doctrinalNote: This is the crux of the four foundations of mindfulness: halt at feeling, and do not let it ripen into craving.
examples: Hearing praise (contact) brings glad feeling; without mindfulness, craving for more follows.

PD_08.name: 愛
PD_08.description: 對可愛境界之貪愛渴求與執念。
PD_08.doctrinalNote: Craving is the Origin of suffering among the Four Noble Truths. The ending of craving is the ending of suffering — Nibbāna.
examples: Seeing delicious food, craving arises: wanting to eat more.
Meeting pain, craving for non-existence arises: wanting not to be.

PD_09.name: 取
PD_09.description: 執著所愛不捨，頑強固執如火捉薪。
examples: Not only wanting money (craving) but being unable to let money go (clinging).

PD_10.name: 有
PD_10.description: 引發後世生存之業有與受生所依之生有。
examples: One who gives generously all their life builds wholesome sense-sphere becoming and is reborn wealthy in the next life.

PD_11.name: 生
PD_11.description: 諸蘊於各生存界之最初顯現受生。
PD_11.doctrinalNote: The three-life circle joins here: birth (PD_11) corresponds to consciousness (PD_03) on the result side of the future life.
examples: The moment of conception is birth — all suffering follows from it.

PD_12.name: 老死
PD_12.description: 諸蘊衰邁成熟而衰老，命根斷絕破損而命終。
PD_12.doctrinalNote: Liberation means ending ignorance (PD_01) and craving (PD_08) — the realisation of Nibbāna.
examples: Every being that has been born must age and die.
When ignorance and craving are destroyed, ageing-and-death no longer follow.

KM_T_01.name: 現法受業
KM_T_01.description: 第一速行所造，於現生結成果報之業。
KM_T_01.doctrinalNote: Immediately-effective kamma has only a single opportunity to mature, within the very same life. If it fails to ripen in that life, it becomes defunct (ahosi-kamma).
examples: Giving alms with a pure mind and reaping the benefit within this very life
The five heinous deeds (matricide, patricide, killing an Arahant, wounding a Buddha, causing a schism in the Sangha) ripen as hell in the very next life

KM_T_02.name: 次生受業
KM_T_02.description: 第七速行所造，於緊隨之來世結成果報之業。
KM_T_02.doctrinalNote: It has only a single opportunity to ripen, in the immediately following life. If it fails to ripen in that life, it becomes defunct.
examples: One who practises meditation in this life is reborn as a Brahmā in the next life

KM_T_03.name: 後後便受業
KM_T_03.description: 中五速行所造，從第三生起至證涅槃前皆可感果之業。
KM_T_03.doctrinalNote: It never becomes defunct through lapse of time — one reason the stream of kamma and its results is so intricate. It is the most common of the three time-based kinds of kamma.
examples: The kamma of building a temple in a past life ripens as wealth many lives later

KM_T_04.name: 既有業
KM_T_04.description: 已造作但失去感果機緣或已被對治而不再受報之業。
KM_T_04.doctrinalNote: 'Ahosi' means 'it has already been' — the kamma is not destroyed, it has simply lost its opportunity to ripen.
examples: For an Arahant, every kamma not yet ripened becomes defunct after final passing away (parinibbāna)

KM_P_01.name: 重業
KM_P_01.description: 力量至重之業（如五逆罪或深妙禪定），必優先先受報。
KM_P_01.doctrinalNote: Generative kamma determines the entire foundation of a life.
examples: Sense-sphere wholesome kamma generates rebirth as a human being or a deva
Kamma that has attained jhāna generates rebirth as a Brahmā

KM_P_02.name: 臨死業
KM_P_02.description: 臨命終時憶起或造作之業，引向次生結生。
KM_P_02.doctrinalNote: It is not the one who sows the seed but the one who waters it — it strengthens and extends a result that is already ripening rather than producing a new one of its own.
examples: A person who performs wholesome deeds every day — supportive kamma increases their lifespan and health

KM_P_03.name: 慣行業
KM_P_03.description: 生前經常重複熏習、積習成性之堅強業習。
KM_P_03.doctrinalNote: This explains why a person who does good may still encounter difficulty.
examples: A wealthy person who is often ill — obstructive kamma diminishes the enjoyment of their fortune

KM_P_04.name: 已作業
KM_P_04.description: 除上述三者之外，偶爾所作而未加深習之零散舊業。
KM_P_04.doctrinalNote: This is the most powerful kind of kamma classified by function; it explains the sudden reversals that occur in a life.
examples: A wealthy person suddenly loses their entire fortune — destructive kamma cuts off the earlier generative kamma

KM_U_01.name: 生產業
KM_U_01.description: 引生結生識及名色之業，產生一期生命的果報。
KM_U_01.doctrinalNote: Weighty kamma always determines rebirth — it never becomes defunct.
examples: Wholesome: attaining the second jhāna generates rebirth in the second-jhāna Brahmā realm
Unwholesome: committing matricide leads to rebirth in the Avīci hell

KM_U_02.name: 支持業
KM_U_02.description: 輔助支持生產業所感果報，使樂受或苦受增盛延續。
KM_U_02.doctrinalNote: This explains the importance of preparing one's mind at the time of death.
examples: Recalling a wholesome act of giving while dying leads to a wholesome rebirth
Seeing a vision of hell while dying leads to a woeful rebirth

KM_U_03.name: 阻礙業
KM_U_03.description: 壓迫阻礙生產業，縮短其福壽或消減其惡報。
KM_U_03.doctrinalNote: This is why the Buddha taught that one should constantly practise wholesome deeds.
examples: Someone who has killed for a living their whole life — a strong unwholesome habitual kamma
Someone who recites scripture and meditates daily — a strong wholesome habitual kamma

KM_U_04.name: 毀壞業
KM_U_04.description: 以更強業力徹底切斷摧毀原有生產業之相續果報。
KM_U_04.doctrinalNote: It is the weakest kind of kamma by priority of ripening, yet it makes up the greater part of the total kamma we have accumulated.
examples: The ordinary, scattered wholesome or unwholesome actions of everyday life

KM_R_01.name: 欲界不善業
KM_R_01.description: 十惡業道，能感四惡趣苦果。
KM_R_01.doctrinalNote: Unwholesome kamma is the cause of the truth of suffering; it belongs to the sense sphere and ripens within the woeful planes of the sense sphere.
examples: Killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, lying — these ripen as rebirth in a woeful state
Greed, hatred and delusion produce unwholesome kamma

KM_R_02.name: 欲界善業
KM_R_02.description: 十善業道，感人界與六欲天善趣樂果。
KM_R_02.doctrinalNote: Sense-sphere wholesome kamma that ripens as happiness in the sense sphere — the foundation for all merit.
examples: Giving, observing precepts and practising sense-sphere meditation ripen as a human or a sense-sphere deva
The ten courses of wholesome action: three bodily, four verbal, three mental

KM_R_03.name: 色界善業
KM_R_03.description: 五禪色界善心，感得色界十六梵天果報。
KM_R_03.doctrinalNote: Fine-material-sphere kamma belongs to the exalted (mahaggata) category, transcending the sense sphere; it ripens according to the jhāna attained.
examples: Attaining the first fine-material jhāna generates rebirth in the Brahma-pārisajja realm
Attaining the fifth jhāna generates rebirth in the Vehapphala realm

KM_R_04.name: 無色界善業
KM_R_04.description: 四無色定善心，感得無色界四天果報。
KM_R_04.doctrinalNote: Supramundane kamma does not produce rebirth within the three realms; it produces Nibbāna as its result — the ultimate aim of the Abhidhamma.
examples: Developing the Noble Eightfold Path to attain the first path cuts off three fetters, ending rebirth in the four woeful states
The four paths produce the four fruits — the only way leading out of suffering

VT_NGU_MON_RATLON.name: 極極大所緣五門心路
VT_NGU_MON_RATLON.description: 十七心剎那具足之完整五門心路，至彼所緣而滅。
VT_NGU_MON_RATLON.arisingCondition: 當清晰的五門或意門所緣撞擊相應根門並擾動有分心流時生起。
VT_NGU_MON_RATLON.significance: 展示了心識從潛意識有分流轉向所緣、造作善惡業並回歸有分的完整生命認知過程。
VT_NGU_MON_RATLON.doctrinalNote: Atimahanta = an object great enough to allow Javana × 7 plus Tadārammaṇa × 2.

1.name: 過去有分
1.description: 在所緣撞擊根門前，心識處於正常流淌的有分狀態。
1.doctrinalNote: 與結生心、死心為同一種心。

2.name: 有分波動
2.description: 所緣撞擊淨色根與有分，有分心產生兩次波動。
2.doctrinalNote: 心識開始受到外在所緣的擾動。

3.name: 有分截斷
3.description: 有分心流完全中斷，心識準備轉向外門認知。

4.name: 五門轉向
4.description: 捨棄有分心流，轉向撞擊五根門的所緣。

5.name: 雙五識
5.description: 眼識（或耳、鼻、舌、身識）在相應根門處直接知悉所緣。
5.doctrinalNote: 純粹的感知，伴隨捨受或苦樂受。

6.name: 領受心
6.description: 從前五識處接收該所緣。

7.name: 推度心
7.description: 對接收到的所緣進行初步審查推度。
7.doctrinalNote: 伴隨喜受或捨受之無因異熟意識界。

8.name: 確定心 (意門轉向)
8.description: 確定該所緣的屬性，為速行心造業開闢道路。
8.doctrinalNote: 在五門心路中執行確定作用。

9.name: 速行 (Javana)
9.description: 七個連續的速行心剎那，在此處造作善或不善業。
9.doctrinalNote: 具造業能力之強力心識階段。

10.name: 彼所緣 (Tadārammaṇa)
10.description: 兩個彼所緣心剎那，繼續領受速行留下的所緣餘味。
10.doctrinalNote: 僅在極極大所緣中出現。

11.name: 後有分
11.description: 認知過程結束，心識回歸潛意識的有分流。

VT_NGU_MON_LON.name: 極大所緣五門心路
VT_NGU_MON_LON.description: 五門極大所緣心路，具足七速行但無彼所緣。
VT_NGU_MON_LON.arisingCondition: 當清晰的五門或意門所緣撞擊相應根門並擾動有分心流時生起。
VT_NGU_MON_LON.significance: 展示了心識從潛意識有分流轉向所緣、造作善惡業並回歸有分的完整生命認知過程。
VT_NGU_MON_LON.doctrinalNote: It differs from the very-great-object process only in lacking the 2 registration moments.

1.name: Vibrating bhavaṅga
1.description: The life-continuum vibrates as the object strikes the sense base.

2.name: Arrest bhavaṅga
2.description: The bhavaṅga stream is cut off — the process begins.

3.name: Five-door adverting
3.description: Turns the mind toward the object through the five-sense door.

4.name: Five-fold sense consciousness
4.description: Knows the object through the corresponding sense.

7.name: Determining
7.description: Determines the object, opening the way for the impulsions.

8.name: Impulsion (Javana)
8.description: Seven impulsion moments create kamma. Afterwards there is NO registration.
8.doctrinalNote: After the 7 impulsions the mind drops straight back into the life-continuum.

9.name: Post-process bhavaṅga
9.description: The life-continuum resumes after the process.

VT_Y_MON.name: 意門心路
VT_Y_MON.description: 心識通過意門接觸法所緣所生起之心路過程。
VT_Y_MON.arisingCondition: 當清晰的五門或意門所緣撞擊相應根門並擾動有分心流時生起。
VT_Y_MON.significance: 展示了心識從潛意識有分流轉向所緣、造作善惡業並回歸有分的完整生命認知過程。
VT_Y_MON.doctrinalNote: The mind-door process begins with the mind-door adverting consciousness (CI_029), without passing through five-door adverting.

1.name: Vibrating bhavaṅga
1.description: The life-continuum vibrates as the mind object strikes.

2.name: Arrest bhavaṅga
2.description: The life-continuum is arrested — the mind-door process begins.

3.name: Mind-door adverting
3.description: Opens the mind door and directs the mind to the mind object, at the same time determining it (serving as determining within this process).
3.doctrinalNote: CI_029 serves both as mind-door adverting and as determining. 11 mental factors.

4.name: Impulsion (Javana)
4.description: Seven impulsion moments — creating mind-kamma. All deliberate thought, speech, and action arise here.
4.doctrinalNote: Creates mind-kamma directly. Verbal and bodily kamma also begin at the mind door.

5.name: Registration (optional)
5.description: Registration in the mind-door process — depending on the strength of the mind object.

VT_VITHIMUTTA.name: 離路心
VT_VITHIMUTTA.description: 不由任何根門、運作於認知過程之外的結生、有分、死心。
VT_VITHIMUTTA.arisingCondition: 當清晰的五門或意門所緣撞擊相應根門並擾動有分心流時生起。
VT_VITHIMUTTA.significance: 展示了心識從潛意識有分流轉向所緣、造作善惡業並回歸有分的完整生命認知過程。
VT_VITHIMUTTA.doctrinalNote: Process-free consciousness creates no new kamma — it is kammically indeterminate resultant mind.

1.name: Rebirth-linking consciousness
1.description: The first consciousness of the new life — continuing directly from the previous life's dying consciousness, carrying kamma's seed.
1.doctrinalNote: CI_019/CI_026 = a two-rooted person; CI_027 = a specially favoured person; CI_063–CI_070 = a three-rooted person or a deva.

2.name: Life-continuum consciousness
2.description: The stream of consciousness that sustains the life between processes. It arises and passes innumerable times, and is the foundation of all mental activity.
2.doctrinalNote: Bhavaṅga = the life-maintaining part of the stream. It runs in deep sleep and between processes.

3.name: Death consciousness
3.description: The final mind-moment — the material life faculty perishes, the death consciousness falls, and the life ends. Immediately afterwards the next life's rebirth-linking consciousness arises.
3.doctrinalNote: Cuti = to move on, to depart. The object of the death consciousness is the death-proximate (āsanna) object.

M1_BASICS.title: 七遍一切心心所
M1_BASICS.description: 每一個心識中必然生起的七個普遍心所，構成一切心識活動的基石。

lessonSections.title: 通一切心心所與遍一切心心所
lessonSections.summary: 通一切心心所包含七遍一切心心所與六別境心心所，隨相應心而轉為善或不善。
body: Aññasamāna（通一切/同他）：Añña意為「其他」，Samāna意為「共同」——即與其他心共同。它們隨與之相伴的心而顯現為善或不善。
通一切心心所分為兩組：遍一切心心所（Sabbacittasādhāraṇa）共七種，別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）共六種。
七遍一切心心所為：觸（Phassa）、受（Vedanā）、想（Saññā）、思（Cetanā）、一境性（Ekaggatā）、命根（Jīvitindriya）與作意（Manasikāra）。
之所以稱為「遍行」，是因為這七種心所必定生起於每一個心識之中，無一例外。

keyTerms.meaning: 隨相伴的心而顯現為善或不善的心所。
必定伴隨一切心識生起的七種共中心所。
只生起於特定心識的六種偶發心所。

sourceRefs.note: TÂM SỞ TỢ THA – AÑÑASAMĀNA; liệt kê Biến hành 7 và Biệt cảnh 6

lessonSections.title: 觸（Phassa）與受（Vedanā）
lessonSections.summary: 觸是心識與所緣的接觸，觸為受的食糧，緣觸而生起感受。
body: Phassa源於詞根「phas」：意為接觸、碰觸。每當心識與所緣相遇，觸心所即行運作。
在五蘊世間：當根（眼耳鼻舌身）與境（色聲香味觸）相遇，識即生起——此時觸心所當下現前。每一根門僅觸及各自的專屬境。
在四名蘊世間（無色界）：即使無物質色法，只要心與所緣相接，觸心所即自然生起。
Vedanā源於詞根「vid」：意為領納、體驗。當所緣觸及心流時，受心所負責承受並體驗該所緣。
重要因果關係：觸是受的食糧（觸食）——因觸為緣而生起感受（觸緣受）。

keyTerms.meaning: 心識與所緣之間的接觸與撞擊。
領納並體驗所緣滋味的心所。

sourceRefs.note: I.1/ TÂM SỞ XÚC – PHASSA
Xúc phân theo cõi và theo hướng
I.2/ TÂM SỞ THỌ – VEDANĀ; Xúc là vật thực cho Thọ

lessonSections.title: 想（Saññā）與思（Cetanā）
lessonSections.summary: 想負責標識與辨識相狀；思統領俱生法造作業，思即是業之本質。
body: Saññā = saṃ + ñā：認識曾經知曉之事物，通過標識與印記再認所緣。
想依性類可分三種：不善想、善想、無記想；依所緣對象可分六種（色想、聲想等）。
Cetanā（思）、Citta（心）與Cetasika（心所）均源自詞根「CIT」：意為思量、知覺。思是最關鍵的造作心所。
思之殊勝功用：不僅履行自身職責，更能調動組織俱生一切心心所共同活動——佛陀開示「我說思即是業」。

keyTerms.meaning: 識別並標明所緣相狀的心所。
統攝俱生心法、造作善惡行業之意志心所。

sourceRefs.note: I.3/ TÂM SỞ TƯỞNG – SAÑÑĀ
I.4/ TÂM SỞ TƯ – CETANĀ, nhiệm vụ đặc biệt, tạo nghiệp

lessonSections.title: 一境性（Ekaggatā）、命根（Jīvitindriya）與作意（Manasikāra）
lessonSections.summary: 一境性專住所緣，命根維持名色生命相續，作意引導心識導向所緣。
body: Ekaggatā：eka（單一）+ agga（焦點/峰頂）→ 心之一境性，即定。將心與心所系縛安住於單一所緣，保持心流不散亂動搖。
Jīvitindriya：Jīvita是壽命（維持名法之生存），Indriya是根（統御支配諸俱生法）。命根統管俱生法的存續。
命根分兩種：名命根維持名法存在三個小剎那（生、住、滅）；色命根維持物質色法存在五十一個小剎那（十七心剎那×三小剎那）。
Manasikāra：Manasī（在心中）+ kāra（造作）→ 在心中造作，即注意力。作意將對象導引為心識之所緣。
作意之四種相義：特相是指引俱生法面向所緣；作用是系縛心心所於所緣上；現起是直接面對所緣；近因是所緣本身。

keyTerms.meaning: 心專一安住於單一所緣的定力心所。
維持俱生名法與色法存續相續的支配力心所。
把持心與心所引向特定所緣的注意心所。

sourceRefs.note: I.5/ TÂM SỞ NHẤT HÀNH (ĐỊNH) – EKAGGATĀ
I.6/ TÂM SỞ MẠNG QUYỀN – JĪVITINDRIYA; 3 và 51 sát na tiểu

reviewCards.front: 「Aññasamāna」（通一切/同他）是什麼意思？
reviewCards.back: Añña意為「其他」，Samāna意為「共同」→「與其他心共同」。它們隨與之俱生的心識而轉為善或不善。

reviewCards.front: 列舉七個遍一切心心所（Sabbacittasādhāraṇa）。
reviewCards.back: 觸（Phassa）、受（Vedanā）、想（Saññā）、思（Cetanā）、一境性（Ekaggatā）、命根（Jīvitindriya）、作意（Manasikāra）。

reviewCards.front: 為什麼它們被稱為「遍一切心心所」？
reviewCards.back: 因為這七個心所必定生起於每一個心識之中，沒有任何例外。

reviewCards.front: 別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）共有幾種？
reviewCards.back: 共6種：尋（Vitakka）、伺（Vicāra）、勝解（Adhimokkha）、精進（Vīriya）、喜（Pīti）、欲（Chanda）。

reviewCards.front: 「觸」（Phassa）源於哪個詞根，其含義為何？
reviewCards.back: 源於詞根「phas」，意為碰觸、接觸或與所緣相遇。

reviewCards.front: 觸（Phassa）與受（Vedanā）之間有何關係？
reviewCards.back: 觸是受的食糧（觸食）——以觸為緣，方能生起感受（觸緣受）。

reviewCards.front: 「想」（Saññā）在詞源上如何解析？
reviewCards.back: Saññā = saṃ + ñā：認識曾經知曉的事物，通過標記和相狀以便日後憶起再認。

reviewCards.front: 思（Cetanā）、心（Citta）與心所（Cetasika）源自哪個詞根？
reviewCards.back: 均源自詞根「CIT」：意為知覺、思考或思量。

reviewCards.front: 為什麼「思」（Cetanā）在業的造作中被視為最核心的心所？
reviewCards.back: 因為思不僅統攝並協調諸俱生心所，而且思的意志本身即構成業（「我說思即是業」）。

reviewCards.front: 「一境性」（Ekaggatā）在詞源上如何解析？
reviewCards.back: Eka（單一）+ agga（頂端/焦點）→ 心之一境性、心的定止與專注於一處。

reviewCards.front: 名命根維持精神名法存續多長時間？
reviewCards.back: 維持三個小剎那：生（uppāda）、住（ṭhiti）與滅（bhaṅga）。

reviewCards.front: 色命根維持物質色法存續多長時間？
reviewCards.back: 維持五十一個小剎那 = 十七個心識剎那 × 三小剎那。

reviewCards.front: 「作意」（Manasikāra）在詞源上如何解析？
reviewCards.back: Manasi（在心中）+ kāra（造作/作為）→ 在心中造作，指引心識導向所緣的注意力。

reviewCards.front: 作意（Manasikāra）的作用（kicca）是什麼？
reviewCards.back: 統馭並指引心識及俱生心所精準投向所緣對象。

quizSeeds.question: 遍一切心心所（Sabbacittasādhāraṇa）共有多少個？
quizSeeds.explanation: 遍一切心心所共有7個，必定俱生於每一個心識之中：觸、受、想、思、一境性、命根與作意。

quizSeeds.question: 下列哪一個心所不屬於七遍一切心心所？
quizSeeds.explanation: 尋（Vitakka）屬於六個別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）之一，並非七遍行心所。

quizSeeds.question: 「Aññasamāna」（通一切/同他）是什麼意思？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 與其他心共同——隨所伴隨之心的性質而顯現為善或不善
quizSeeds.explanation: 通一切心所本身在倫理上是非決定的，隨其所相伴的心識之善惡而轉變為善或不善。

quizSeeds.question: 「觸」（Phassa）的核心定義是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 心識與所緣對象之間的碰觸或相遇
quizSeeds.explanation: 觸的特相是接觸所緣（phusanā）。

quizSeeds.question: 「觸食」（phassāhāra）是什麼意思？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 觸作為滋養生起感受的條件與食糧
quizSeeds.explanation: 佛經指出「觸緣受」，觸是感受得以生起的不可或缺的資糧。

quizSeeds.question: 「想」（Saññā）的主要作用是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 通過先前獲知的相狀與記號進行辨識與標記
quizSeeds.explanation: 想心所為對象做標記，以便日後再次遇到時能夠辨識再認。

quizSeeds.question: 哪一個心所構成了「業」的本質？
quizSeeds.explanation: 佛陀開示：「諸比丘，我說思即是業」（Cetanāhaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ vadāmi）。

quizSeeds.question: 「一境性」（Ekaggatā）源於哪些詞語？
quizSeeds.explanation: Ekaggatā字面意為心集中於單一焦點的一境性（定）。

quizSeeds.question: 色命根維持物質色法存續多少個小剎那？
quizSeeds.explanation: 一個色法持續17個心識剎那，每個心剎那含生、住、滅3小剎那，共51小剎那。

quizSeeds.question: 名命根維持精神名法存續多少個小剎那？
quizSeeds.explanation: 精神名法僅持續1個心識剎那，包含生、住、滅3個極微細的小剎那。

quizSeeds.question: 作意（Manasikāra）的作用（kicca）是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 調馭並引導俱生心心所導向所緣對象
quizSeeds.explanation: 作意猶如舵手，負責將相伴的心法準確引向目標所緣。

quizSeeds.question: 在無色界（僅有四名蘊、無色法）中，「觸」如何生起？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 純粹通過心識與法所緣之間的碰觸而生起
distractors: 仍必須依賴眼耳等六種物質根身
無色界中不存在觸心所
需要淨色根作為物質支撐
quizSeeds.explanation: 在無色界中完全沒有物質肉身，觸心所純粹生起於心識與精神所緣的接合中。

M11_BIET_CANH.title: 六別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）
M11_BIET_CANH.description: 尋、伺、勝解、精進、喜、欲六種別境心所，隨所伴隨之心的性質而顯現為善或不善。

lessonSections.title: 通一切心所中的別境心所
lessonSections.summary: 別境心所共有六種，只散見於特定心識之中，倫理上隨所伴隨之心的善惡而轉變。
body: 通一切心心所（Aññasamāna，同他心所）分為兩組：七遍一切心心所與六別境心心所（Pakiṇṇaka）。
之所以稱為「別境」，是因為這六種心所並非生起於一切心，而是僅選擇性地散見於特定的心識之中。
六別境心所為：1. 尋（Vitakka），2. 伺（Vicāra），3. 勝解（Adhimokkha），4. 精進（Vīriya），5. 喜（Pīti），6. 欲（Chanda）。
因為屬於通一切心所，它們本身非純善亦非純惡：伴隨善心則成為善，伴隨惡心則成為不善。

keyTerms.meaning: 僅生起於特定心識之中的六種偶發心所。
倫理性質非決定、隨俱生心善惡而轉化的十三心所。

sourceRefs.note: II. TÂM SỞ BIỆT CẢNH – PAKIṆṆAKA CETASIKA, có 6: Tầm, Tứ, Thắng giải, Cần, Hỷ, Dục

lessonSections.title: 尋（Vitakka）與伺（Vicāra）
lessonSections.summary: 尋將心引向所緣，伺令心持續審查撫摩所緣；二者皆不生於雙五識。
body: Vitakka：前綴「Vi」（殊勝/特別）+ 詞根「takk」（思忖、思惟）→ 專門的尋思，將心識投向對象。
尋的主要特相：將俱生諸心所引向並安置於所緣之上，猶如將諸心法直接投向目標。
尋之四種相義：特相是將俱生法導向所緣；作用是令心心所撞擊所緣；現起是心引至所緣相見；近因是所緣及三名蘊。
Vicāra：前綴「Vi」+ 詞根「car」（遊行、徘徊）→ 伺察，在所緣上反復盤旋審查，緊密貼合撫摩所緣。
經典生動比喻：尋如蜂直投蓮花，如大鳥展翅升空，如擊鐘之聲；伺如蜂在蓮花上徘徊盤旋，如鳥在空中滑翔翱翔，如鐘聲綿延餘韻。
尋與伺完全不生起於雙五識（十識），因為雙五識只是機械地受所緣撞擊而生起，無需尋思觀察。

keyTerms.meaning: 將心識與心所投向所緣的尋思心所。
在所緣上反復盤旋審查、緊密貼合的審察心所。

sourceRefs.note: II.1 TÂM SỞ TẦM – VITAKKA CETASIKA; đặc tính chánh yếu và tứ ý nghĩa
II.2 TÂM SỞ TỨ – VICĀRA CETASIKA; phân biệt Tầm–Tứ; không có trong Ngũ song thức

lessonSections.title: 勝解（Adhimokkha）
lessonSections.summary: 勝解令心識擺脫猶疑、決斷判定所緣；存在於一百一十個心識之中。
body: Adhimokkha：前綴「Adhi」+ 詞根「muc」（釋放、解脫）→ 使心擺脫懷疑猶疑而確信果斷，即勝解、確立判定。
勝解之四相義：特相是堅決決斷打破猶豫；作用是令心對所緣確定無疑；現起是果斷決定之狀態；近因是需要判決的所緣。
判決分為兩類：邪勝解（以是為非、以非為是）與正勝解（如實確立是非）。
勝解不生於雙五識（10心）及疑相應癡根心（1心）——共扣除11心，遍存於其餘110個心識之中（121 − 11 = 110）。

keyTerms.meaning: 對所緣斷定無疑、確立堅信的心所。

sourceRefs.note: II.3 TÂM SỞ THẮNG GIẢI – ADHIMOKKHO CETASIKA; tứ ý nghĩa; phán quyết tà/chánh; có mặt trong 110 tâm

lessonSections.title: 精進（Vīriya）
lessonSections.summary: 精進是勇悍堅持的努力，支持俱生法不後退，以四正勤為最高實踐。
body: Vīriya：源於「Vīra」（勇士、勤奮者）→ 努力、勤勉、策勵、支持俱生心法堅忍不拔。
精進之四相義：特相是勇悍支持；作用是支助俱生法不萎靡退轉；現起是不後退沉淪；近因是令人悚懼警醒的所緣（生老病死等逼迫苦境）。
精進分邪精進（如勤勉從事欺詐惡事）與正精進（四正勤）。
四正勤：已生惡令斷滅、未生惡令不生、未生善令生起、已生善令增長鞏固。
精進之四階段：精進根（統治力）、精進力（不可動搖之力量）、精進覺支（導向開悟）、正精進（斬斷輪迴證達涅槃）。

keyTerms.meaning: 勇悍策勉心識與俱生法不懈努力的心所。
斷惡生善的四種圓滿正精進修行。

sourceRefs.note: II.4 TÂM SỞ CẦN – VIRIYA CETASIKA; tứ ý nghĩa; Tứ Chánh cần; 4 khía cạnh

lessonSections.title: 喜（Pīti）與欲（Chanda）
lessonSections.summary: 喜是心生歡喜愉悅，具有五級層次；欲是意欲作為，善法欲是解脫之動力。
body: Pīti：源於「Pī」（歡悅）→ 歡喜、適悅、心曠神怡、身心暢快喜樂。
修定之五種喜：小喜（汗毛豎立微喜）、剎那喜（如電光閃現之瞬喜）、繼起喜/海潮喜（如波浪拍岸之湧喜）、踴躍喜（身輕騰空之飄喜）、遍滿喜（遍布充盈全身的深妙喜）。
依性類分三種喜：善喜（隨喜他人善業、禪定喜支）、不善喜（沉溺五欲之樂、戰勝仇敵之狂喜）、無記喜（阿羅漢之唯作喜）。
Chanda：源於詞根「Chad」（意願、樂意）→ 欲作、欲求，本身中性非善非惡。
欲分三種：貪欲（執取五欲之貪，五蓋之一屬不善）、善法欲（如意足之一，向往布施、持戒、禪修之善意樂）、唯作欲（阿羅漢之作意思願）。
欲不生於二癡根心及十八無因心——這些心屬於機械受緣觸擊之過程，無主動意欲活動。

keyTerms.meaning: 對所緣感到歡悅喜受的心所。
意欲去作、採取行動的意願心所。

reviewCards.front: 「別境」（Pakiṇṇaka）是什麼意思？
reviewCards.back: 指僅散見生起於特定心識之中，而非生起於一切心識的心所。

reviewCards.front: 六個別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）分別是哪六個？
reviewCards.back: 尋（Vitakka）、伺（Vicāra）、勝解（Adhimokkha）、精進（Vīriya）、喜（Pīti）、欲（Chanda）。

reviewCards.front: 「尋」（Vitakka）在詞源上如何解析？
reviewCards.back: 前綴「Vi」（特殊）+ 詞根「takk」（思量）→ 專門的尋思，將心識引向所緣。

reviewCards.front: 尋（Vitakka）的主要特相是什麼？
reviewCards.back: 將心識與俱生心所舉起並安放在所緣目標之上。

reviewCards.front: 「伺」（Vicāra）的含義與作用是什麼？
reviewCards.back: 在所緣上反復巡視、審查並緊密貼合撫摩所緣。

reviewCards.front: 經典中用哪些比喻來區別尋與伺？
reviewCards.back: 尋如蜂投花、鳥展翅、擊鐘聲；伺如蜂盤旋、鳥滑翔、鐘聲餘響。

reviewCards.front: 尋與伺在哪些心識中完全不生起？
reviewCards.back: 雙五識（十識：眼耳鼻舌身識）中完全不生起尋與伺。

reviewCards.front: 「勝解」（Adhimokkha）是什麼意思？
reviewCards.back: Adhi + muc（釋放）→ 令心擺脫猶豫疑惑，堅決果斷決定所緣。

reviewCards.front: 勝解（Adhimokkha）存在於多少個心識之中？
reviewCards.back: 存在於110個心中（121心扣除10雙五識與1疑相應癡心）。

reviewCards.front: 精進（Vīriya）的四相義是什麼？
reviewCards.back: 特相是勤勉勇悍；作用是支持俱生法；現起是不後退沉淪；近因是悚懼警醒之因。

reviewCards.front: 什麼是「四正勤」（Sammāpadhāna）？
reviewCards.back: 已生惡令斷除、未生惡令不生、未生善令生起、已生善令增長。

reviewCards.front: 「欲」（Chanda）可以分為哪三類？
reviewCards.back: 貪欲（不善染著）、善法欲（善法意願/如意足）、唯作欲（阿羅漢無執欲作）。

quizSeeds.question: 別境心所（Pakiṇṇaka）共有多少個？
quizSeeds.explanation: 別境心所共有6個：尋、伺、勝解、精進、喜、欲。

quizSeeds.question: 下列哪一個心所不屬於別境心所？
quizSeeds.explanation: 作意（Manasikāra）屬於七遍行心所，而非別境心所。

quizSeeds.question: 「尋」（Vitakka）的首要功用是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 將心識與俱生心所投向安立於所緣之上
distractors: 在所緣上反復盤旋巡視
quizSeeds.explanation: 尋的作用是舉心投向所緣（ārammaṇe cittassa abhiniropana-lakkhaṇo）。

quizSeeds.question: 哪一個比喻恰當地形容了「伺」（Vicāra）？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 蜜蜂在蓮花上方盤旋巡視
quizSeeds.explanation: 伺如蜂在花上盤旋撫摩，體現持續審察撫摩所緣之義。

quizSeeds.question: 在哪些心識中心所「尋」與「伺」完全缺席？
quizSeeds.explanation: 雙五識由於極度單純直接，無需尋伺心所。

quizSeeds.question: 「勝解」（Adhimokkha）在字面上的根本涵義是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 解脫疑慮而達成果斷堅決的判定
quizSeeds.explanation: 勝解是擺脫猶豫搖擺而決然堅信其境。

quizSeeds.question: 勝解（Adhimokkha）存在於多少個心識之中？
quizSeeds.explanation: 在121心中，扣除10個雙五識與1個疑相應心，共110心。

quizSeeds.question: 四正勤（Sammāpadhāna）的內容是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 斷已生惡、防未生惡、生未生善、增已生善
quizSeeds.explanation: 四正勤是精進修行的圓滿四項要求。

quizSeeds.question: 在禪修經論中，喜（Pīti）被劃分為幾個層次等級？
quizSeeds.explanation: 五種喜為小喜、剎那喜、繼起喜、踴躍喜與遍滿喜。

quizSeeds.question: 阿羅漢心識中所生起的「喜」屬於何種性質？
quizSeeds.explanation: 阿羅漢的一切心行皆是無業報的唯作（kiriya）。

quizSeeds.question: 阿羅漢願意去弘法利生的心理動能稱為什麼？
distractors: 造作後世善果的善法欲
quizSeeds.explanation: 阿羅漢無貪亦無新造善業，其意樂純為唯作法欲。

quizSeeds.question: 在哪些心識中心所「欲」（Chanda）完全不存在？
quizSeeds.explanation: 癡根心被蒙昧主導，無因心機械反映，二者皆無欲（Chanda）。

M2_SI_PHAN.title: 癡分心所（Mocatuka）
M2_SI_PHAN.description: 十四不善心所中的四個普遍不善心所（癡、無慚、無愧、掉舉），遍存於一切不善心識中。

lessonSections.title: 不善心所與癡分心所
lessonSections.summary: 不善心所共有十四種，其中癡分四心所遍生於一切十二不善心。
body: 不善心所（Akusala cetasika）共有十四種。
不善（Akusala）具有五種義蘊：(1) 病患——引生痛苦；(2) 醜陋——鄙惡不淨；(3) 不善巧——被貪瞋癡遮蔽理智；(4) 過失——有過咎；(5) 招感苦果。
癡分心所（Mocatuka cetasika）共有四種：癡（Moha）、無慚（Ahirika）、無愧（Anottappa）、掉舉（Uddhacca）。
這四個心所被稱為「通一切不善心所」（不善遍行），因為它們普遍存在於一切十二不善心之中，作為不善心理活動的前導與基石。

keyTerms.meaning: 與不善心相應、造作惡業的十四種心所。
以癡為首的四個通一切不善心所（癡、無慚、無愧、掉舉）。

sourceRefs.note: I/ TÂM SỞ SI PHẦN – MOCATUCACETASIKA; 5 nghĩa của Akusala

lessonSections.title: 無慚與無愧
lessonSections.summary: 無慚是不自恥惡行，無愧是不畏懼惡果，二者總是形影相隨。
body: 無慚（Ahirika）：對於惡行不感到羞恥，造作惡業時不知自恥的心態。
無愧（Anottappa）：對惡行的後報毫無畏懼與顧忌，不畏惡果的心態。
經典論典強調：無慚與無愧必定同生並起——凡有無顧忌之處，必有無羞恥，二者密不可分。
此二心所直接對抗美遍行中的「慚」（Hiri）與「愧」（Ottappa）二種出世護法。

keyTerms.meaning: 對惡行無羞恥之心。
對惡業後果無怖畏顧忌之心。

sourceRefs.note: I.2/ TÂM SỞ VÔ TÀM – AHIRIKA CETASIKA
VÔ TÀM + VÔ QUÝ: cả 2 luôn đi chung

lessonSections.title: 掉舉（Uddhacca）
lessonSections.summary: 掉舉是心不寂靜、動搖散亂的狀態，遍行十二不善心，障蔽禪定樂支。
body: Uddhacca：U（向上）+ 詞根 dhu（搖動、震動）→ 向上浮動、動盪不寧、散亂掉舉。
論中生動比喻：猶如馬蹄剛觸地便急遽騰空移向別處；如魚脫水拼命掙扎；如心剛緣一境又被拉扯到別處；如聚雲被風吹散；如微塵隨風飛揚。
修學綱要：掉舉遍在於全部十二不善心中；與四名蘊相應；與色蘊不相應；性類屬不善；全分攝入不善本性中。
掉舉是五蓋之一（掉悔蓋），在禪支中直接與「樂」（Sukha）相對立。

keyTerms.meaning: 心浮躁動盪、無法安止於單一所緣的散亂心所。

sourceRefs.note: I.4 TÂM SỞ PHÓNG DẬT – UDDHACCA CETASIKA

reviewCards.front: 不善心所（Akusala cetasika）共有多少種？
reviewCards.back: 共有十四種不善心所。

reviewCards.front: 「不善」（Akusala）在阿毗達摩中有哪五種義蘊？
reviewCards.back: 病患（引生痛苦）；醜陋不淨；不善巧（障蔽理智）；有過失；招感苦報。

reviewCards.front: 癡分心所（Mocatuka）包含哪四種心所？
reviewCards.back: 癡（Moha）、無慚（Ahirika）、無愧（Anottappa）、掉舉（Uddhacca）。

reviewCards.front: 為什麼癡分心所被稱為「通一切不善心所」（不善遍行）？
reviewCards.back: 因為這四個心所必定生起於全部十二不善心的每一個心識之中。

reviewCards.front: 什麼是「無慚」（Ahirika）？
reviewCards.back: 對於造作惡行不知羞恥、無慚愧心的心理狀態。

reviewCards.front: 什麼是「無愧」（Anottappa）？
reviewCards.back: 對惡行的可怕異熟果報毫無懼怕、不畏罪果的心態。

reviewCards.front: 無慚與無愧能否單獨分開生起？
reviewCards.back: 不能。二者在一切不善心中必然同生並起，形影不離。

reviewCards.front: 「掉舉」（Uddhacca）在詞源上如何解析？
reviewCards.back: U（向上）+ 詞根 dhu（搖動）→ 向上浮動、心浮躁動搖、散亂不寧。

reviewCards.front: 論中用哪些生動的比喻來形容掉舉（Uddhacca）？
reviewCards.back: 馬蹄觸地即離、魚躍出水撲騰、浮雲隨風吹散、塵土隨風飛揚。

reviewCards.front: 掉舉作為五蓋之一，直接障蔽對抗哪一個禪支？
reviewCards.back: 掉舉直接對抗障蔽禪定中的「樂」（Sukha）禪支。

quizSeeds.question: 癡分心所（Mocatuka）包含多少種心所？
quizSeeds.explanation: 癡分心所共有4種：癡、無慚、無愧、掉舉。

quizSeeds.question: 為什麼癡分心所被稱為「通一切不善心所」？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 因為它們生起於全部12個不善心之中
distractors: 因為它們能生起於善心中
因為它們只生起於癡根心
quizSeeds.explanation: 癡分四心所遍行於全部十二不善心，無一例外。

quizSeeds.question: 不善心所（Akusala cetasika）總共有多少種？
quizSeeds.explanation: 不善心所總計14種（癡分4、貪分3、瞋分4、昏沉、睡眠、疑）。

quizSeeds.question: 「無慚」（Ahirika）的具體含義是什麼？
quizSeeds.explanation: 無慚是以對惡行不感羞恥為特相。

quizSeeds.question: 無慚與無愧之間的關係如何？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 它們在所有不善心中必定形影相隨一同生起
distractors: 無慚只在貪根心，無愧只在瞋根心
quizSeeds.explanation: 無慚與無愧屬於不善遍行，在一切不善心識中必定同時俱生。

quizSeeds.question: 掉舉（Uddhacca）的心理狀態是什麼？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 心浮躁動搖、散亂不寧、無法定止
quizSeeds.explanation: 掉舉的特相即是如被風吹動的灰塵般動盪不寧。

quizSeeds.question: 掉舉（Uddhacca）存在於多少個不善心中？
quizSeeds.explanation: 掉舉是通一切不善心所之一，遍存於全部12不善心。

quizSeeds.question: 阿毗達摩中闡釋了「不善」（Akusala）的幾種義蘊？
quizSeeds.explanation: 不善具五義：病患、醜陋、不善巧、有過失、招感苦報。

quizSeeds.question: 掉舉直接障蔽對抗哪一個禪支？
quizSeeds.explanation: 在五蓋中，掉舉追悔蓋直接障礙並破壞禪支中的樂（Sukha）。

quizSeeds.question: 癡分四心所在不善法中扮演什麼角色？
quizSeeds.correctAnswer: 充當一切不善心識的前導和普遍基石
distractors: 僅是偶發生起的伴隨者
quizSeeds.explanation: 癡分四心所是一切罪惡與不善活動的根本前驅與基石。
